digest.component_or_area: code-review gate model-class wiring / LLM runner
propositions: The code-review gate declares model classes on its five LLM-calling steps but every declaration is silently ignored at runtime, running all passes on the single resolved cfg.model.

The root cause is that PydanticAIRunner.run discards req.config and resolves the model from the config it was constructed with, so the per-step model computed by RunnerAgentStep and the batch runner is thrown away.

usage_log.record() records only the prompt name (op) and cannot attribute a call to a step, so step id and declared class must be threaded via a ContextVar to make per-step model attribution possible.

The fix substitutes req.config.model into a copy of the runner config via _effective_config, honouring declared classes for both single-shot prompt steps and batch steps without leaking across shared-runner steps.

An offline end-to-end recording-runner test beneath the production agent step must observe each step receiving its declared class under a class table differing from cfg.model, failing red on pre-fix code.
The same discard affected plan-review per-call configs, and honouring the Pass-1 finder's declared cheapest rung moves it to a cheaper model, a landing-blocking behaviour change filed separately.
